replacements.before: ~curious~ Four targets. Hit two at once. The makers kept *ink bombs* in there for stubborn engines. They left tools near their problems.
replacements.after: ~curious~ Hit all four open vents quickly. An *ink bomb* can catch several; splash the rest before they close. The makers left tools near their problems.

replacements.before: ~neutral~ And it pours. There’s a tap by every hub: shut it, and the channels go cold.
replacements.after: ~neutral~ The channels carry molten iron. Shut a tap by a hub to stop the pour and drain them.

replacements.before: ~solemn~ The ledger says it stops when a moon comes out whole. So give it a whole one.
replacements.after: ~solemn~ The ledger says a whole moon makes it stop and look. That gives you an opening.

replacements.before: ~neutral~ An iron moon, drawn into its cradle. You’ll want the glove for that.
replacements.after: ~neutral~ Use the glove to draw an iron moon into its cradle. Then splash its heart when the crucible doors open.
